confirmation_rule.run: python scripts/06_validate_emotion_labels.py (after 180 labels; re-label sheet optional)
confirmation_rule.title_primary_if: goemotions_title kappa CI lower bound > goemotions_weighted kappa CI upper bound
confirmation_rule.hold_if: intra-rater kappa CI upper bound < 0.4 (labels too unreliable to act on)
confirmation_rule.otherwise: confirm v1 (only 'status' changes; hashed content unchanged)
confirmation_rule.not_validated_by_labels: continuous go_pct_*, go_vad_*, go_dist_*, vad_valence: the 6-class labels do not test them directly; they stay unless a source rule above removes them
confirmation_rule.any_change: new file config/emotion_spec_v2.json + decision log entry + test hash entry
